title: English for Banking and Finance – in English

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Use listening and speaking skills in English for banking and finance at an advanced level.
Develop reading and writing skills in English for banking and finance at an advanced level.
Expand vocabulary, terminology, and structures specific to financial markets in English.
Understand functions and operations of banks and apply this knowledge to analyze financial activities or solve practical problems.
Understand the nature and strategies of risk management in banks and apply this knowledge to analyze financial activities or solve practical problems.
Understand the characteristics, functions, participants, and operations of financial markets and apply this knowledge to analyze financial activities or solve practical problems.
Understand the nature, functions, and operations of financial instruments in financial markets and apply this knowledge to analyze financial activities or solve practical problems.
Demonstrate information gathering skills and perform analysis of activities at a specific bank and financial market within the financial system.
Demonstrate professional ethics and social responsibility.
